verdict.rationale: SigNoz ships its own export paths in open formats: dashboards can be downloaded as JSON specs, panels as CSV, and telemetry is OpenTelemetry-native and queryable via ClickHouse SQL. The self-hosted open-source edition also keeps the data plane under the user's control. However, no documented bulk export of all traces, logs and metrics exists, and the migration guides only cover moving into SigNoz, not out of it. missing for 10: documented bulk export of all raw telemetry (traces/logs/metrics) in open formats, a documented exit/offboarding path especially for SigNoz Cloud, export of alerts and other configuration, independent hands-on corroboration of leaving.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
